test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A sum of ₹1,456, when invested for ten years, amounts to ₹2,366 on maturity. Find the rate of simple interest per annum that was to be paid on the sum invested.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Simple Interest for 10 years = ₹2,366 − ₹1,456 = ₹910.

Interest for 1 year = ₹910 ÷ 10 = ₹91.

Rate % = (Interest for 1 year ÷ Principal) × 100

Rate % = (91 ÷ 1456) × 100 = 6.25%.

**∴ The correct answer is 6.25%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹1,456

Amount (A) = ₹2,366

Time (T) = 10 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (I) = Amount (A) − Principal (P)

Rate (R) = (I × 100) ÷ (P × T)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24427a7c0e2205c03ff19dc6069f551a8e71b4ea5e60812d85464c96608d0700.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI = ₹2,366 − ₹1,456

⇒ SI = ₹910

⇒ R = (910 × 100) ÷ (1456 × 10)

⇒ R = 91000 ÷ 14560

⇒ R = 9100 ÷ 1456

⇒ R = 25 ÷ 4

⇒ R = 6.25%

**∴ The correct answer is 6.25%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest (SI)

It is the interest calculated only on the initial principal amount. The principal remains constant throughout the tenure. Formula: SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Amount (A)

It is the total sum of money payable at the end of the time period, which includes the original principal and the interest accumulated. Formula: A = P + SI.

Compound Interest (CI)

Interest calculated on both the initial principal and the accumulated interest from previous periods. Formula: A = P(1 + R ÷ 100)T.
